note: Hand-edited from the model's proposal (work/taxonomy-proposed.json): near-duplicates merged, non-visual moves folded into other, reveal_one_by_one added. v2: definitions of the most-confused pairs sharpened after the first audit (kappa 0.60).

kinds.name: highlight_part
kinds.definition: Make one part stand out on the spot (recolour, pulse, flash, underline) while everything else stays as bright as before; if the others are dimmed or removed it is focus_isolate.

kinds.name: enclose_part
kinds.definition: Draw an outline, box, circle or brace around a part or group to mark it out; the shape is the point.

kinds.name: cross_out
kinds.definition: Strike through or mark something as ruled out, wrong or cancelled (a cross, a strike line); not simply removing it.

kinds.name: focus_isolate
kinds.definition: Single out one item by dimming, fading or removing the others, so only it stays bright; if nothing else changes it is highlight_part.

kinds.name: point_at
kinds.definition: An arrow or pointer indicating one location, cell or item (a marker that may later move).

kinds.name: label_or_measure
kinds.definition: Attach a short name, value, coordinate or dimension to a specific object already on screen (a tag next to it); a standalone equation is write_formula.

kinds.name: reveal_one_by_one
kinds.definition: Bring in or count items one after another (staggered or lagged entrances, a tally) so the order or the count is the point; a layout appearing at once is show_structure.

kinds.name: write_formula
kinds.definition: Write a new standalone equation, law or expression on screen; changing an expression already shown is transform_formula, a tag on an object is label_or_measure.

kinds.name: transform_formula
kinds.definition: Morph an expression already on screen into a rearranged, simplified or equivalent form (one step of a derivation); a brand-new expression is write_formula.

kinds.name: substitute_values
kinds.definition: Replace symbols in an expression with numbers or other terms (and the reverse: generalise numbers back into symbols).

kinds.name: compute_example
kinds.definition: Work a concrete numeric example step by step, ending with its result shown.

kinds.name: compare_side_by_side
kinds.definition: Place two or more cases, quantities or objects next to each other to contrast them; both stay visible.

kinds.name: overlay
kinds.definition: Superimpose one thing on another (a curve on a histogram, a shape on its copy) so they can be matched.

kinds.name: swap_case
kinds.definition: Replace one version with another in the same place, or step through several discrete cases one at a time.

kinds.name: move_object
kinds.definition: Move a thing along a path or to a new place (slide, travel, send), keeping its shape.

kinds.name: sweep_scan
kinds.definition: Move a marker or window systematically across a range, array or structure to examine each part.

kinds.name: vary_parameter
kinds.definition: Change one named value continuously (a value tracker, slider, set_value) and let everything that depends on it follow.

kinds.name: grow_shrink
kinds.definition: Change the size or proportion of a thing, or stretch one of its dimensions.

kinds.name: transform_space
kinds.definition: Deform a shape or the whole plane by a mapping (rotate, shear, apply a matrix, warp).

kinds.name: decompose_split
kinds.definition: Break a thing into its parts or pieces to show its structure.

kinds.name: combine_gather
kinds.definition: Bring separate pieces together, stack them, or sum them into one thing.

kinds.name: connect_map
kinds.definition: Draw lines or arrows showing how things relate, flow or map to each other (between two or more things).

kinds.name: show_structure
kinds.definition: Lay out a table, grid, tree, list, timeline or diagram that organises items in space, appearing as a whole; one-by-one entrance is reveal_one_by_one.

kinds.name: plot_graph
kinds.definition: Draw a function, curve or data on axes, or change the axes/scale of a plot.

kinds.name: show_distribution
kinds.definition: Show a probability distribution, histogram or bar chart of values, or many samples piling into one.

kinds.name: run_process
kinds.definition: Let a dynamic process, simulation or random experiment play out over time on its own clock (updaters, time stepping), not driven by one named value.

kinds.name: geometric_construction
kinds.definition: Add an auxiliary line, point, angle, chord or shape to a figure to build an argument.

kinds.name: show_field
kinds.definition: Fill space with arrows, flow lines or colour showing a field.

kinds.name: two_views
kinds.definition: Show one thing in two representations at once, tied together (a curve and its formula, arrows and a matrix).

kinds.name: zoom_in
kinds.definition: Magnify the view onto a detail.

kinds.name: zoom_out_reset
kinds.definition: Widen or restore the view, reframe the camera, or bring back an earlier view.

kinds.name: fade_remove
kinds.definition: Remove, dim or clear things no longer needed (including wiping the scene).

kinds.name: setup
kinds.definition: Just establishing objects before anything is explained, with no move of its own.

kinds.name: other
kinds.definition: A remark, question, transition or note with no visual move, or a comment too vague to tell even from the code.
